curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With an innocent captain condemned to exile for treason, the lingering question is how a military hierarchy's corrupt certainty might ever be challenged.
curatedMovie.description: In 1894, French army Captain Alfred Dreyfus faces a devastating miscarriage of justice when he is wrongfully convicted of treason and sentenced to life imprisonment on the brutal Devil's Island penal colony.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A slow-burning, emotionally heavy French period thriller demanding engaged, focused attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Roman Polanski crafts a deliberate, suspenseful historical thriller about institutional failure, mounting paranoia, and the devastating human cost of a fabricated verdict.
